versions.content: Decomposition of Safety Requirements Type: valid Description: It shall be possible to express the decomposition of a safety requirement into two independent safety requirements. Rationale: ASIL decomposition is a concept provided in ISO 26262 to reduce the ASIL of a safety requirement by splitting it into independent safety requirements. ASIL decomposition should also be available for AUTOSAR systems. Use Case: [UC_SAFEX_00001], [UC_SAFEX_00002], [UC_SAFEX_00007] Dependencies: [RS_SAFEX_00010], [RS_SAFEX_00001] Supporting Material: see ISO 26262-9 [1]
